description: Read a Plumbline order draft as it stands: its fields and companies (with their keys), what it still needs before it can be sent, the indicative price, what changed since it was sent, the firm offer with its terms hash, the order, payment and report state, recent changes by the buyer in the app or by you, and what can happen next. Read it before acting on what the buyer says about the order: they may have changed it in the app.

since.description: The stamp of the state you last read; an unchanged draft answers {unchanged: true}

token.description: The draft's private token (also the receipt token of every request sent from it); keep it private

name: get_order_draft
title: Read the order draft
